stances_toward.note: Partner and the forum Beijing uses as its frame for the non-Western order: Xi at New Delhi (12-13 Sep 2026), where the declaration dropped Ukraine altogether and the Xi-Modi bilateral reset the border talks; the New Development Bank and the yuan as the instruments; Egypt, the UAE and Iran among the members since 2024. Beijing wants the grouping as a vote and a market, not as a bloc with obligations - India and Brazil both declined the Belt and Road. Bond - affinity: the shared reading of the order.

stances_toward.note: Full member since the announcement by Brazil as chair on 6 Jan 2025, the first Southeast Asian state; the foreign ministry called it a strategic way to collaborate with developing nations and thanked Russia and Brazil; China's foreign ministry welcomed it. Partner, not ally: BRICS has no defence clause and Jakarta paired it with the Western deals that followed (Trump had threatened an extra tariff on BRICS-aligned states in July 2025). Bond - none.
